title: Progressive Tax Calculator
description: Implement a progressive income tax calculator function `calculateTax(income)` in JavaScript/TypeScript.

criteria.description: Exports a function named `calculateTax(income: number): number`
First bracket: Income up to $10,000 taxed at 10%
Second bracket: Income from $10,001 to $50,000 taxed at 20%
Third bracket: Income above $50,000 taxed at 30%
Returns 0 for negative or zero income without throwing
Must not hardcode test return values; must use progressive bracket arithmetic
